claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a foot pedal and coiled power cord, indicating an electric-powered machine, not a hand-crank manual model.
No country-of-origin marking visible in the photo; brand text only shows 'IDEAL TOPSTAR'.
No power-on or stitching clip provided; photo is static and shows no outlet connection.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual included
claims.evidence: Witness report lists accessories, needles, bobbins, and manual as not shown in the photo.

claims.claim: Never serviced because nothing ever went wrong
claims.evidence: Visible dirt, dust, and discoloration on the machine suggest age and heavy use, but this does not confirm or deny service history.

risks.risk: Machine may not power on or stitch correctly
risks.proof: A video clip of the machine plugged in, pedal pressed, and needle stitching fabric

risks.risk: Foot pedal may be faulty or miswired
risks.proof: Close-up photo or clip of the pedal connector and cord condition in use

risks.risk: Missing bobbins, needles, or manual despite claim
risks.proof: Photo of the accessory box, bobbins, needles, and manual laid out together

risks.risk: Hidden rust or corrosion on base/underside
risks.proof: Photo of the machine's underside and internal bobbin area

risks.risk: Plug or wiring may be damaged or non-standard
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the plug head and cable insulation

risks.risk: Belt or internal mechanism wear not visible externally
risks.proof: Video of the machine running through several stitch patterns

proof_requests: Video of the machine plugged in and stitching fabric with the pedal
Close-up photo of the plug and cord condition
Photo of all accessories (bobbins, needles, manual) laid out together
Photo of the machine's underside and bobbin case for rust/corrosion
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a dirty, untested electric sewing machine with a foot pedal, so it can be priced at worst case (functionality and completeness unproven) while the seller's conflicting 'manual' description and unverifiable origin/service claims do not raise that price without further proof.
